provider.description: The tax calculation provider this account uses. Defaults to `stripe` when not using a [third-party provider](/tax/third-party-apps).

tax_behavior.description: Default [tax behavior](https://stripe.com/docs/tax/products-prices-tax-categories-tax-behavior#tax-behavior) used to specify whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. If the item's price has a tax behavior set, it will take precedence over the default tax behavior.

tax_code.description: Default [tax code](https://stripe.com/docs/tax/tax-categories) used to classify your products and prices.
